fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $11 billion, up 378% year-over-year, with non-GAAP gross margin reaching 85.1%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Data center segment revenue reached $4.8 billion, up 61% quarter-over-quarter, exabyte shipments grew 330% year-over-year, and remaining performance obligations (RPO) of $88.9 billion secure future demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: Generated adjusted free cash flow of $5.7 billion last quarter, but current stock price has fallen 65% from June highs ahead of an 8-for-1 stock split scheduled for November 20.
